title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 22
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 22: David prepares materials for Yahweh's house and charges Solomon to build it.

questions.text: Whom did David order to be gathered together to work on God's house?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 22:2 says David gave orders to gather the foreigners who were in the land of Israel, and set masons to cut dressed stones.

answers.text: The foreigners in the land of Israel

questions.text: For what did David prepare iron in abundance?
questions.explanation: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the couplings.

answers.text: For swords and spears for the army
For the nails for the doors of the gates
For the wheels of the king's chariots
For the altar of burnt offering

questions.text: Who brought cedar trees in abundance to David?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.

answers.text: The Sidonians and the people of Tyre

questions.text: How did David describe Solomon when he explained why he was making preparations?
questions.explanation: David said, "Solomon my son is young and tender," so he prepared abundantly before his death.

questions.text: Why did Yahweh's word say that David should not build a house to his name?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's word said, "You have shed blood abundantly, and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name."

answers.text: He was too old to see it finished
He had shed blood abundantly and made great wars
He had no gold or silver left for it
The land was not yet at rest from famine

questions.text: What kind of man would the son born to David be, according to Yahweh's word?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "A son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace," and he would give him rest from all his enemies.

questions.text: What did David ask Yahweh to give Solomon so that he might keep the law of Yahweh?
questions.explanation: David said, "May Yahweh give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel."

questions.text: What did David tell Solomon after saying he would prosper if he observed the statutes?
questions.explanation: David said, "Be strong and courageous. Don't be afraid, and don't be dismayed."

answers.text: Wait for a sign from heaven

questions.text: How much gold had David prepared for Yahweh's house in his affliction?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says he prepared one hundred thousand talents of gold, along with one million talents of silver and bronze and iron without weight.

questions.text: Whom did David command to help Solomon his son?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says David commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son.

answers.text: The kings of Tyre and Sidon
